page.layout: One page: a blank tan cover board (the scan shows a book cover, not a text page) with a single printed bookplate pasted in the centre. No text block, no margins with text.
page.notes: The scan shows a bound book's cover board with no printed text on the page itself. The only printed matter is a library bookplate (ex libris label) in the centre, with a red and black ornamental border. Its lines read: "JOHN CARTER BROWN LIBRARY" / "Acquired with the Assistance of the" / "ST. MARIANA DE PAREDES FUND". It is an ownership label, comparable to a library stamp, so it is left out of the main text. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible.
